items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 with GIF creation, faster generation, and two new API models
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Images 2.6：支援 GIF 創作、生成速度提升 50%，並發布兩款新 API 模型
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Images 2.6 for ChatGPT, Codex, and the API on November 4. The update generates images 50% faster than the prior version, adds native GIF creation from prompts or images (with frame editing and speed control), and introduces saved reference images. In the API, GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst are available; Flare can return results in as little as six seconds at low quality, while Sunburst prioritizes higher fidelity and edit consistency.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 4 日宣布在 ChatGPT、Codex 與 API 推出 Images 2.6。新版影像生成速度較前代提升 50%，支援從提示詞或圖片直接生成 GIF（可編輯單幀與調整播放速度），並新增可重複使用的參考影像功能。API 端同步推出 GPT-Image-2.6 Flare 與 Sunburst：Flare 在低品質設定下最快約 6 秒出圖，Sunburst 則強調更高細節與多輪編輯一致性。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release expands OpenAI’s image stack from static generation into lightweight animation and tighter iterative editing, which matters for consumer and developer workflows that previously required separate tools. Speed and consistency gains are incremental rather than a new paradigm; real impact will depend on how reliably character and brand details hold across multi-step edits in production use.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此更新將 OpenAI 的影像能力從靜態生成延伸到輕量動畫與更緊密的迭代編輯，對原本需要額外工具的消費者與開發者工作流程有實用價值。速度與一致性提升屬於漸進式改善而非全新範式，實際影響仍取決於多輪編輯中角色與品牌細節的穩定度。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, bringing your ideas to life faster. With this, you can bring motion to your images with GIFs — from animating a brand mascot or character to turning a product shot into an eye-catching loop.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們在 ChatGPT、Codex 與 API 推出 Images 2.6，讓你的想法更快實現。透過 GIF，你可以為影像加入動態——從動畫品牌吉祥物或角色，到把產品照片變成吸睛的循環動畫。

items_flat.title_en: Riot Platforms names Anthropic as tenant of $28B Corsicana, Texas campus lease
items_flat.title_zh: Riot Platforms 披露 Anthropic 為德州 Corsicana 校園約 280 億美元租約承租方
items_flat.summary_en: In its Q3 2026 10-Q filed November 4–5, Riot Platforms identified Anthropic PBC as the counterparty to a 15-year lease covering 910 MW of critical IT capacity at its Corsicana, Texas campus, valued at roughly $28 billion in contracted revenue over the initial term (higher with extensions). The same tenant is linked to an earlier Rockdale lease. Capacity is scheduled in phases through mid-2028; financing terms include a possible 12% interest mechanism on reimbursements if project debt is unavailable.
items_flat.summary_zh: Riot Platforms 於 11 月 4–5 日提交的 Q3 2026 10-Q 中，將 Anthropic PBC 列為其德州 Corsicana 校園 910 MW 關鍵 IT 容量 15 年租約的承租方，初期合約價值約 280 億美元（若行使延長選項更高）。同一承租方也與先前的 Rockdale 租約相關。容量預計分階段交付至 2028 年中；融資條款包含若無法取得專案債務時，償還款項可能適用 12% 年利率機制。
items_flat.analysis_en: The disclosure confirms Anthropic as a major long-term power and capacity customer of a Bitcoin-miner-turned-data-center landlord, underscoring the scale of compute commitments frontier labs are locking in years ahead of delivery. Delivery timelines, grid constraints, and the unusual financing clause remain key execution risks for both parties.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此披露確認 Anthropic 是比特幣礦商轉型資料中心房東的大型長期電力與容量客戶，凸顯前沿實驗室正提前多年鎖定算力規模。交付時程、電網限制與特殊融資條款，對雙方都是關鍵執行風險。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer to deepen Codex code infrastructure
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將收購 Pierre Computer，強化 Codex 程式碼基礎設施
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 4 that it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, the startup behind Code Storage and open-source developer tools (Trees and Diffs) already used in Codex. The deal aims to advance source control for agentic coding workflows; Pierre’s open-source projects will remain open-source, and Code Storage features are planned for integration into Codex. Closing is subject to customary conditions including regulatory approvals.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 4 日宣布將收購 Pierre Computer Company。該新創推出 Code Storage 以及已用於 Codex 的開源開發者工具（Trees 與 Diffs）。此收購旨在強化代理式程式開發的原始碼控制能力；Pierre 的開源專案將維持開源，Code Storage 功能則計劃整合進 Codex。交易完成仍需滿足包括監管批准在內的慣例條件。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move gives OpenAI more control over the storage and review layer that coding agents depend on, positioning Codex as a more self-contained platform rather than relying solely on external Git hosts. Whether this creates meaningful differentiation versus GitHub will depend on how quickly the integrated experience ships and how open the remaining tooling stays.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉讓 OpenAI 更能掌控程式代理所依賴的儲存與審查層，使 Codex 朝向更自洽的平台發展，而非完全仰賴外部 Git 託管。相較 GitHub 能否形成實質差異，取決於整合體驗的推出速度與剩餘工具的開放程度。
items_flat.quote: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc. ... Once the acquisition closes, our ambition is to advance the future of source control across the industry.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 OpenAI 將收購 Pierre Computer Company, Inc。……收購完成後，我們的目標是推動整個產業的原始碼控制未來發展。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic biology team uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a bacterial vault particle
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 生物學團隊運用 Claude 繪製首個細菌 vault 粒子 3D 結構
items_flat.summary_en: On November 4 Anthropic published research from its biology team showing that Claude assisted at multiple stages—sequence search, isolation optimization, and structure determination—to produce the first 3D cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle assembled from a bacteriophage protein (96 copies, ~9.5 MDa). The work expands the known distribution of vaults beyond eukaryotes and demonstrates both acceleration and residual error-correction needs when using the model for experimental biology.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 11 月 4 日發表生物學研究：其團隊運用 Claude 協助序列搜尋、分離優化與結構解析等步驟，完成由噬菌體蛋白組裝而成的 vault 樣粒子首個 3D 冷凍電鏡結構（96 份拷貝，約 9.5 MDa）。此工作將 vault 的已知分布擴展至真核生物之外，同時展示模型在實驗生物學中的加速效果與仍需人工校正的限制。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result is a concrete example of an AI model participating in a multi-step structural biology workflow rather than only literature summarization. Function of vaults remains unknown, so the scientific advance is structural and methodological; broader claims about accelerating discovery still require independent experimental validation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此成果是 AI 模型實際參與多步驟結構生物學工作流程（而非僅文獻摘要）的具體案例。vault 的功能仍未知，因此科學進展主要在結構與方法層面；關於加速發現的更廣泛主張，仍需獨立實驗驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們分享生物學研究團隊如何與 Claude 合作，繪製細菌生命中 vault 粒子的首個 3D 結構。

items_flat.title_en: Cat Wu, former Claude Code product lead, joins OpenAI to lead Core Products PM
items_flat.title_zh: 前 Claude Code 產品負責人 Cat Wu 加入 OpenAI，領導核心產品產品管理
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5 Cat Wu announced on X that she is joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products, after stating that her last day at Anthropic was late October. She previously led product for Claude Code and Cowork. OpenAI confirmed the hire; she is expected to work with existing product leads including Thibault Sottiaux.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11 月 5 日 Cat Wu 在 X 宣布加入 OpenAI，領導核心產品的產品管理工作。她先前表示 10 月底為 Anthropic 最後工作日，並曾負責 Claude Code 與 Cowork 的產品。OpenAI 已確認此人事安排，她預計將與包括 Thibault Sottiaux 在內的現有產品負責人合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move is a notable talent shift in the coding-agent race between Claude Code and Codex. Product leadership continuity at Anthropic on its highest-visibility developer tool is now interrupted; impact on either company’s roadmap will depend on how quickly Wu ramps and what priority OpenAI assigns to agentic coding surfaces.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此人事異動是 Claude Code 與 Codex 程式代理競爭中的顯著人才流動。Anthropic 在其最受關注開發者工具上的產品領導連續性被打斷；對任一方產品路線的實際影響，取決於 Wu 上手速度以及 OpenAI 對代理式程式介面的優先級安排。
items_flat.quote: Some news: I’m joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products! I have a lot of respect for OpenAI for showing the world that scaling works, for bringing AI to over a billion people, and for believing great products are core to the mission.
items_flat.quote_zh: 一些消息：我即將加入 OpenAI，領導核心產品的產品管理工作！我很尊敬 OpenAI 向世界證明擴大規模有效、將 AI 帶到超過十億人，並相信優秀產品是使命的核心。
